title: dedicated: autoscaler - burst controls + fleet utilization reporting (v9)
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Introduce burst-aware autoscaling controls and per-fleet utilization reporting. Changes include a new burst_budget model, autoscaler policy changes to account for short-term burst capacity (min_burst, burst_window_ms, burst_decay), consumable burst tokens tracked per-fleet, a reporting endpoint for fleet-level utilization and burst consumption, and observability additions (metrics + dashboards). This PR also adds toggle flag 'enable_burst_reporting' behind a feature flag and a migration to create the burst_budget table. Motivation: customers with variable spiky traffic need predictable throughput guarantees while allowing short bursts without immediate scale-up costs. This improves utilization visibility for Dedicated customers and enables billing/alerting on burst consumption. Checklist: [x] migration + model + repo updates [x] autoscaler integration [x] API/reporting endpoint [x] metrics and dashboards [x] unit + e2e tests [x] docs update [ ] monitor runbook updates (follow-up). Related Linear items: ENG-5234, ENG-5342.
